title: Rustorio building prototype
description: content/buildings/*.json — data for a building reusing an existing archetype's Java behavior.

label.description: A plain string, or an object of locale code to string. Falls back to "en", then to the id.

archetype.description: Whose Java behavior this building borrows. Genuinely new behavior needs a jar mod.

category.description: Which build-panel tab this building appears under. Optional; omitted means the 'Other' tab, so every file written before this key existed still loads. A bare name resolves against rustorio ("logistics" == "rustorio:logistics"), the same convention item and kind references follow; a namespaced value becomes a tab of its own.

item.description: Bare name (this mod's own namespace) or a full namespace:path reference.

placement.description: Where this building may stand. One of the vanilla rule names in the uppercase spelling every building file has always used, or a bare/namespaced reference to a rule some code mod registered — the loader resolves both (BuildingJsonLoader.parsePlacement), and the two spellings cannot collide because a ContentId path is lowercase.

texture.description: Sprite id. A mod's own PNG under <mod>/textures/<name>.png registers as <mod>:<name>.

bufferMax.description: How much this building holds: a Furnace-archetype's input buffer, a Pipe-archetype's fluid volume.

kind.description: This building's recipe pool. Defaults to its own id — a private pool nothing else shares.

fuel.description: Bare name (this mod's own namespace) or a full namespace:path reference.

fluidInput.description: Which fluid this building draws from the network behind it. Boiler-archetype only.

fluidOutput.description: Which fluid this building pushes into the network it faces. Pump- and Boiler-archetype only.

power.description: What this building does with electricity. A building without this key is not electrical at all, which is what keeps power opt-in.

radius.description: Pole-archetype: how many cells around itself it covers and connects across.

demand.description: Power needed per tick. A machine that does not get it stops and reports NO_POWER.

speedTech.description: Which technology, once unlocked, halves this building's timing. MINER/ELECTRIC_MINER-, FURNACE/PRESS/ASSEMBLER- and LAB-archetype only. Omit to inherit the archetype's own vanilla gate (e.g. a JSON FURNACE still speeds up under fast_smelting); name a technology (including one this mod defines) to replace it outright.

visibleWhen.description: When this building appears in the HUD and may be placed. Absent means always available. Leaf keys: produced (item), placed (building id), unlocked (tech), effect (tech effect id). Combinators: any, all — each holds an array of nested rules.
